text:
ashley: lon1 control-plane alert — multiple health checks failing, autoscaler can't provision new GPU nodes. Seeing sustained 5xx from api-server and scheduler errors.
cloud-monitor-bot: ALERT: region=lon1 severity=critical — control-plane heartbeat lost, control-plane-apis unavailable (>=5m). https://status.cloudprovider.example/incidents/ABC-123
praveen: i'm seeing the same from our side. provider console times out for lon1. starting quick checks on BGP, VPC route tables, and IPAM.
kai: are data-plane VMs still up? can we exec into any pods or is scheduling completely broken?
ashley: some VMs respond to SSH but k8s scheduling returns 503. `kubectl get nodes` shows many NotReady and several kubelets failing to register.

matt: checked VPC: route-table rt-0a1b2c shows a route for 0.0.0.0/0 -> blackhole (code: BGP_FLAP_DETECT). multiple subnets in lon1 lost default gateway.
diana: autoscaler logs show repeated failures when allocating IPs for new GPU nodes: `error: cannot assign secondary IP: no available addresses in subnet lon1-gpu-subnet-1`.
``
2026-03-18T09:10:32Z autoscaler: request node-pool-gpu-5 -> provisioning
2026-03-18T09:10:33Z network: allocate_secondary_ip failed: exhausted
2026-03-18T09:10:33Z autoscaler: provisioning failed: IP allocation
```
praveen: sounds like two things: provider IPAM exhaustion and a route table flap causing control-plane reachability loss. i've opened a P1 ticket with provider (INC-RED-8877) and pasted trace link.

ashley: immediate mitigation suggestions?
praveen: 1) shift new traffic away from lon1 to neighboring regions (eu-west1, lon2) via smart-router policy. 2) drain non-critical workloads from lon1. 3) enable cross-region fallback for Dedicated customers. 4) keep provider ticket hot and request emergency IPAM expansion.

kai: i'll run the router policy change: `redwood-router update-policy --from lon1 --to eu-west1 --weight 0.9 --reason "control-plane degradation"` and start draining non-essential nodepools.

grace: support seeing customer errors for EU apps. preparing a short status blurb for affected customers, will coordinate with @diana for wording. :warning: 

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1864509876 (lon1 control-plane degradation). PagerDuty alerted to oncall rotation.

diana: drafting customer message now. will include mitigation steps and expected ETA unknown; advising customers to enable cross-region fallback if they haven't.

matt: temp fix idea: provider allowed us a soft route override earlier — can we attempt to re-inject a working default route to affected subnets? Risky but might restore egress for control-plane components.

praveen: do it if confident. prefer provider to fix IPAM but route reinjection is acceptable as a stopgap. note: we need provider approval to avoid split-brain networking.

ashley: proceeding with traffic shift and node draining. Kai — ping when router update completes so we can watch for reduced 5xx in metrics.

kai: router update issued at 1864509978. monitoring route propagation and latency. running `kubectl drain` on non-critical gpu nodepools now.

cloud-monitor-bot: NOTE: new routing policy active (propagation_eta ~30s). Observability: outgoing traffic from lon1 dropping ~78% towards eu-west1.

praveen: provider acknowledged ticket, granted temporary IP pool expansion request pending verification. we'll keep route reinjection as fallback.

grace: customer status posted to status.redwood.ai with initial note. engagement team notified top 10 accounts in affected regions.

diana: customer message sent to EU cohort, asked customers to toggle cross-region failover. will post updates every 15 minutes.

kai: monitoring: control-plane 5xx rate dropped by 60% after routing change; scheduler still shows backlog for GPU provisioning. continuing to poll.

cloud-monitor-bot: Partial recovery detected at 1864511402 — some control-plane endpoints responding, but several subnets still reporting degraded network state. continuing incident.

ashley: good progress but not resolved. we keep incident open, follow up on provider IPAM fix, and prepare escalation to exec if not cleared in 30m. thanks everyone for fast turnaround.
